description_for_human: Cloud Chromium for AI agents — real residential-IP browser, captcha solving, human-in-the-loop takeover.
description_for_model: Drive a real Chromium browser on a clean residential IP. Send a natural-language goal; the platform runs an LLM-driven browser session and returns a concise answer plus a live viewer URL. Use for logging into sites behind CAPTCHA / Cloudflare / anti-bot fingerprinting, scraping behind auth, and any web task an agent cannot do from a datacenter IP. A2A 1.0 and MCP native. Full reference at https://humanbrowser.cloud/llms-full.txt.
